items.item: Every field has a visible label above it; no placeholder is used as the label
items.evidence: Each header field has <label for=... class="mb-1 block"> above the input (Khách hàng, Số hóa đơn, Số đơn đặt hàng, Ngày hóa đơn, Điều khoản thanh toán, Hạn thanh toán, Ghi chú). Placeholders (PO-2026-0187, 'Tìm theo tên hoặc mã số thuế') are only example/hint text. Line-item cells use sr-only labels under visible column headers.

items.item: Field widths match the expected input (dates and quantities are narrow)
items.evidence: Date inputs class 'field w-40', invoice number 'w-44', customer 'max-w-xl', qty column 'w-24', price 'w-36', tax 'w-24'; screenshot shows narrow dates and quantity vs wide product select.

items.item: Required fields are marked with an asterisk
items.evidence: Labels for customer, number, date, due contain '*' plus aria-required; legend '* Bắt buộc' under the title; optional fields (PO number, notes, terms) unmarked.

items.item: Line items can be added and removed; quantities, prices and amounts are right-aligned with tabular figures
items.evidence: #add-line -> addLine(); [data-remove] click handler splices line with undoToast 'Hoàn tác'. Qty/price inputs and amount cell use class 'num' (text-align:right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums); numeric headers text-right. Audit numericCells misaligned 0, nonTabular 0.

items.item: Subtotal, tax and total are computed and right-aligned with locale currency formatting
items.evidence: renderTotals() builds Tạm tính, Thuế GTGT per rate, Tổng cộng with money() = Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN') + ' ₫'; dd elements have class 'num'; screenshot shows 8.510.000 ₫ and tax rows flush right (total row is below the first viewport behind the sticky bar but is rendered in full-page flow).

items.item: Fields validate on blur and on submit; with three or more errors a summary appears and focus moves to the first error
items.evidence: blur listeners on number/date/due/customer call validateField(); line fields use focusout -> errorsShown + refreshErrors(). Submit handler: collect(), renderSummary(all) (shown when all.length >= 3, '<n> mục cần chỉnh sửa' with jump links) then focusId(all[0].id).

items.item: Save is not disabled before submitting; it is disabled only while the submission is in progress
items.evidence: #save has no disabled attribute in markup; only set via '$("save").disabled = true' after validation passes (saving = true) and reset to false in the 900ms setTimeout; spinner #save-spin shown meanwhile.

items.item: Save and Cancel stay reachable in a sticky bar, and leaving with unsaved changes asks for confirmation
items.evidence: #actionbar 'sticky bottom-0' with Hủy then Lưu hóa đơn (visible at bottom of screenshot). guard() shows #leave dialog 'Bạn có thay đổi chưa lưu. Rời đi mà không lưu?' for Cancel and [data-nav] links when isDirty(); beforeunload handler also set.

notes: Dense, neutral enterprise form; no template tells found. Avatar 'HN' is the signed-in user's initials (a person), flat blue/slate palette, radii 4-6px, no gradients/glass/emoji/uppercase tracking/KPI tiles. Audit score 100 with no violations. Minor non-failing observations: Tailwind via CDN; the Tổng cộng row sits below the first viewport (scrolls under the sticky bar); on submit focus goes to the first invalid field rather than the summary, which matches the checklist wording.
